title: NeuroTUMBCI2025: Motor imagery dataset from the neuroTUM 2024 Cybathlon BCI
description: A mobile EEG motor imagery dataset recorded from two pilots, one tetraplegic and one able-bodied, during development of the neuroTUM brain-computer interface for the 2024 Cybathlon BCI race. Data were acquired with a 24-channel wireless Smarting mobi system at 250 Hz using an arrow-cue paradigm. Each pilot performed a subject-specific set of three mental tasks drawn from rest, hand motor imagery and foot motor imagery. The data are provided in BIDS format with HED event annotations.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 24-channel Smarting mobi (mBrainTrain) wireless amplifier at 250 Hz using a 10-20 montage. Each trial consisted of a 3 s fixation reset, a 1 s directional arrow cue, a 3 s black-screen mental task execution, and a 3 s reset. Cue classes were rest, left hand, right hand and feet, and each participant performed a subject-specific subset of three. Recordings were offline with no feedback.
